question: In a certain code language, 'CODE' is written as '5SH3'. How will 'WIRE' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : 

 
• First letter ⇒ (2) is added to the position value according to the English alphabetic series and only position value is written.
 
• Second and third letter letter ⇒ (4) is added to the position value according to the English alphabetic series.
 
• **Fourth letter** ⇒ (2) is subtracted from the position value according to the English alphabetic series and only position value is written.

So,

 
• 'CODE' is written as '5SH3'

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7592394edce17f6055574aa7e455f655a0418ade1c37a4139d476f7a5c60dd60.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• 'WIRE' will be written

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2e3389e86a5580c6fc26540a97fc388d417ac2a8f68e5046c26745d9b6754edc.png] 

​Hence, "**25MV3**" is the correct answer.
